{{Quote|The Drennics follow a man named Drenn. They freelance for the various crime syndicates on Naboo and other planets. His mercenary front-business has begun to overlap our operations, especially in the area of scouting and reconnaissance.|[[Ha'adj|Ha'Adj]], to a mercenary|<ref name="SWG:HE" />}}
The '''Drennics''' were a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:HE" /> Led by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Drenn (Trandoshan)|Drenn]],<ref name="SWG:TT" /> they usually hired themselves out for criminal organizations.<ref name="SWG:HE" /> The Drennics maintained a [[Drennic Bunker|bunker]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SWG:TT" /> and a [[Drennic Listening Post|listening post]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:HE" />
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Drennics appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Drennics were added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:TT" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
